integrity: The complete proof and self-contained exhaustive finite checker are included in the same package; the checker is corroboration rather than a proof for arbitrary order.
scientific_limitations: Only the maximality of unions of two flip-coordinate edge classes is characterized; no claim on maximum size or all maximal sets. The Fibonacci-cube all-pairs case was explicitly noted in 2023 prior literature. Independent assessment and comprehensive publication-priority verification remain open.
title: Triangle-edge criterion for two-direction edge general position in independence flip graphs
